summary: The agent implements a basic regression pipeline with missing value imputation, categorical encoding, and an ensemble of gradient boosted trees. However, it suffers from data leakage due to fitting the LabelEncoder on the test set and computing imputation medians before the train/validation split. Additionally, there is no feature engineering, and the agent fails to retrain the final models on the complete training dataset.
